verified_root_cause: Host background memory usage left ~2.007 GiB available RAM at Stage 2 start (> 2.00 GiB old threshold by 7 MiB), allowing 3 heavy pytest shards (~1.7 GiB combined RSS) simultaneously and dipping available RAM to 326.8 MiB (< 512 MiB ResourceMonitorKH01A safety floor). Also invoking venv/Scripts/python.exe on Windows added launcher stub processes.
remediation_committed_before_new_run: Raised adaptive RAM downshift thresholds in _effective_slot_limit() (1 worker below 2.40 GiB available RAM, 2 workers below 3.30 GiB, 3 workers above 3.30 GiB).
Staged multi-worker benchmarks and 56,710 A1 streaming parity BEFORE loading heavy cand_index/datasets into parent RSS and added explicit gc.collect() barriers.
Used native Python 3.12 interpreter directly on Windows to avoid duplicate pyvenv.cfg launcher stub processes.
